verdict.rationale: Devin is fundamentally a cloud-hosted agent platform: users delegate tasks via web app, Slack/Teams, or API, and cloud Devin sessions run without the developer managing backend infra, with API/session creation supporting org-wide multi-user scale. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of infrastructure-free scaling at volume, and clearer documentation of underlying resource limits or SLAs for the managed cloud service.
